name: Warehouse — Package Sorting
tagline: The right place depends on what you carry.
narrative: Two orders share an 11×5 warehouse aisle loop: one red, one blue. The robot already picks up whatever package it reaches and follows the route around the central rack block. But a delivery action at the wrong coloured outbound is deliberately harmless, so the robot needs to understand both the type of cargo in its hold and the type of the station beneath it. Sort both orders correctly.
objective: Deliver the red package to Red Outbound and the blue package to Blue Outbound.
learningObjective: Conditional logic across two facts: cargo type and delivery-zone type.
intelligenceExplanation: Movement and pickup are already provided. Add a high-priority rule for Red Outbound that checks carryingRed, and another for Blue Outbound that checks carryingBlue. A generic delivery rule would also work in this safe world, but the two typed rules make the sorting decision visible.
hint: Add WHEN deliveryRedHere AND carryingRed → DO deliver. Repeat for blue, and keep both priorities above 60 so route movement cannot skip the station.

goals.description: Deliver every package to the correctly typed outbound.

rules.description: Load a package when capacity is free.
Turn right at the end of an aisle.
